about: Fifteen Days, the coverage plan (owner's rules, 2026-10-17; docs/coverage.md). DRAFTED by the coding agent: positions, setups, variants and which line cuts to which setup. scripts/coverage-plan.py computes the cameras and checks the rules.

FLOOR.what: low on the floor among the hologram towers

hold.action: The holographic walls stand as the last gliders break against them in bursts of light; the crowd in the tiers rises; the huge screen above the floor shows {D}'s calm face.

SCREEN.what: the arena with Deluin's face on the big screen

face.action: The arena: the glowing hologram play floor with its walls and gliders, the crowded tiers rising around it, and above the floor one huge screen showing {D}'s calm face in close-up.

playing.action: {D} in his sunken pit at the glowing console, playing: eyes on the board, hands still, patient, unhurried.

glasses.action: {D} in his sunken pit lifts the cabled glasses off his face with one hand, the other hand empty on the console; a small private closed-mouth smile.

watch.action: At the overlook railing, seen from out over the hall: {Z} on the left leans on the railing watching the game far below, admiring; {B} on the right is bent over the small gadget she is working on, not looking up.

lean.action: At the overlook railing: {B} on the right has set her gadget on the rail and leans out over the railing studying the board below; {Z} on the left watches the game.

dry.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B}, the gadget in her hands, glances at him, dry, unimpressed.

shrug.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B} snaps the gadget's casing shut and shrugs, looking up at him.

wry.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {B} glances sideways at him, wry, a small closed-mouth smile.

eyebrow.action: {Z} close, one eyebrow raised, eyes turned toward her.

admire.action: {Z} close, looking down at the game below, admiring, a small closed-mouth smile; hologram light from below.

toast.action: {B} close, leaning over the railing, face lit from below by the holograms, eyes narrowed, studying the pieces, serious.

EST.what: the corridor from the far end, the elevators along the right wall

wait.action: The long round-topped stone corridor deep under the hall, a row of metal elevator doors along the right wall; {Z} and {B} at their real size, standing waiting by the elevators in the middle distance. Nobody else.

MASTER.what: the two-shot in profile at the elevator: Zei left, Deluin right, Bai behind Zei

arrive.action: The elevator doors stand open; {D} on the right steps out of the elevator, easy and friendly; {Z} on the left, standing, eager, half a step toward him; {B} behind {Z}, arms crossed, bored.

easy.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} in the elevator doorway, easy and friendly, talking.

warm.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} in the elevator doorway, open and warm, asking.

OTS-D.what: over Deluin's shoulder onto Zei (Bai behind him)

eager.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, standing, eager; behind him {B} stands with her arms crossed, bored.

sheepish.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, a small self-deprecating closed-mouth smile, rubbing the back of his neck; behind him {B} with her arms crossed.

delighted.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, delighted, a warm closed-mouth smile; behind him {B} with her arms crossed.

sour.action: {B} close, a shrug and a sour twist of her mouth, arms crossed.

MASTER.what: walking toward us, Zei left, Bai right (passed review)

tease.action: {Z} walking, close, turned three-quarters toward her on the right of the frame, teasing, a closed-mouth smile.

hopeful.action: {Z} walking, close, turned toward her, hopeful, a closed-mouth smile.

serious.action: {B} walking, close, eyes ahead, serious and worried about him, not smiling.

sly.action: {B} walking, close, a sly closed-mouth smile, glancing toward him on the left of the frame.

EST.what: the courtyard café at night from high in a corner

night.action: The courtyard café at night from high in a corner: string lights over the courtyard, small trees, the street gate, the long rectangular wooden table in the middle with {D} and {B} small at it, sitting across from each other; the megastructure skyline beyond. Nobody else.

MASTER.what: the triangle at the long table, from the north-east

wave.action: At the long rectangular table: {D} on the right turns and raises one hand to wave someone over, a soft closed-mouth laugh; {B} across from him looks over too; the chair at the left end is empty.

robot.action: All three at the long rectangular table: {Z} at the left end, {D} on the right, {B} across from him; {R} beside the table, its face screen kind, holding a tray.

menus.action: All three at the long rectangular table, each with a thin glowing menu: {D} on the right, still sitting, leans over toward {Z} on the left to look at his menu and points at it; {B} looks down at hers, unimpressed.

up.action: All three at the long rectangular table: {B} puts her thin menu down and stands; {Z} on the left and {D} on the right both look at her.

apart.action: {Z} on the left and {D} on the right at the long rectangular table, talking; far behind, small, {B} sits alone at a small round table and puts on big headphones; {R} pours tea from a pot into two cups on the long table.

laugh.action: {Z} on the left and {D} on the right at the long rectangular table, both laughing with closed mouths; a little wall of sugar cubes between their cups; far behind, small, {B} at her small round table with headphones on.

call.action: {D} on the right leans out and waves across the courtyard to {B}, small and apart at her small round table with big headphones on; {Z} on the left watches.

talk.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} at the long table, talking, easy and warm.

menu.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} at the long table, a thin glowing menu in hand, modest.

stern.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D}, a mock-stern face with a playful closed-mouth smile: a joking lecture.

eager.action: Over {Z}'s shoulder: {D} leans in, eager and inviting, smiling with his mouth closed.

whoa.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z} at the end of the table, eyes on the thin glowing menu in his hands, surprised.

explain.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, the thin glowing menu in his hands, explaining, keen.

astonished.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, astonished, turned to him.

talk.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z} talking, relaxed; far behind him, small, {B} at her small round table with headphones on.

smile.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, amused, a closed-mouth smile; far behind him, small, {B} at her small round table with headphones on.

watch.action: Over {D}'s shoulder: {Z}, a little embarrassed, smiling with his mouth closed, glances down at the watch on his wrist; far behind him, small, {B} at her small round table.

amused.action: {Z} close, amused, a closed-mouth smile, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.

warm.action: {D} close, warm, thinking about home, looking toward the left of the frame at Zei.

cubes.action: {D} close, looking down at the table as if seeing something for the first time, a small closed-mouth smile.

CU-B.what: Bai at the long table, clean close-up

menu.action: {B} close, glancing down at her thin glowing menu, unimpressed.

standing.action: {B}, standing now, big headphones in her hand, looking down toward the left of the frame at Zei: serious, a straight face, not smiling.

sideeye.action: {B} at her small round table, big headphones on, a handheld in her hands, glancing sideways out of the corner of her eye toward the left of the frame.

what.action: {B} at her small round table turns in her chair toward the left of the frame and lifts one side of her big headphones off one ear, loudly.

MENU.what: the menu: the book's own picture

SUGAR.what: the sugar cubes between the cups, modelled in the set

wall.action: Very close at table height: a neat little wall of small white sugar cubes, two rows high, between two tea cups on the wooden table.

door.action: Very close at table height: the little wall of small white sugar cubes between two tea cups, now with one cube missing from the middle of the bottom row: a doorway.

watch.action: Very close: {Z}'s wrist, orange jacket sleeve pushed back, as he turns it to glance at a plain round watch.

wave.action: At the street gate at dusk: {D} on the right, turning to go into the street, gives a quick wave goodbye; {Z} on the left waves back.

chant.action: {D} close at the gate at dusk, chanting playfully, looking toward the left of the frame at Zei.

smile.action: {Z} close at the gate at dusk, a closed-mouth smile, looking toward the right of the frame at Deluin.
